name: Hervey Bay Whale Watch
summary: Humpback whale watching from Hervey Bay on Quick Cat II, an 18 metre catamaran with three levels of viewing decks, run by a family business that began whale watching here in 1987. Half-day morning and afternoon cruises run in whale season, with packages that add lunch on K'Gari, a helicopter flight or a K'Gari day tour. From November the same boat runs the Aqua Oasis day cruise, with swimming, stand up paddle boards and an inflatable slide.
standouts: Advanced Ecotourism Certified through Ecotourism Australia
Founded in 1987 by Brian and Jill Perry, described as the first commercial whale watching company in Australia
Quick Cat II has ramps instead of stairs on the main deck, giving wheelchair and pram access
Family owned and run, with local crew

contact.address: Berth A1, Great Sandy Straits Marina, 17 Buccaneer Drive, Urangan QLD

trips.title: Morning Whale Watch
trips.summary: A half-day humpback whale watching cruise on Quick Cat II, leaving the marina at 7:00am and returning at 12:30pm. The boat calls at Kingfisher Bay Resort to pick up resort guests, then heads through the Great Sandy Straits to Platypus Bay. A light breakfast and morning tea are served on board, and a hydrophone lets guests listen to whale song underwater.

Hydrophone to listen to whale song underwater
Fully licensed bar for food and drink purchases
Optional whale swim for an extra $100 per person

trips.summary: A package that pairs a Quick Cat II whale watch cruise, morning or afternoon, with a 10 minute helicopter flight over Hervey Bay with Great Ocean Helicopters. The flight leaves from Hervey Bay Airport and passes over Big Woody Island, Moon Point, Pelican Banks and the Urangan pier. The helicopter time is arranged with the helicopter team after booking.

trips.title: Whales & Lunch at K'Gari

Guests spend the afternoon at the resort and return to the mainland on the resort barge at 2:30pm or 5:00pm, then by resort bus to the marina. Activities such as kayaks and stand up paddle boards cost extra.

trips.summary: A two-day package that combines a half-day Quick Cat II whale watch cruise, morning or afternoon, with a full-day K'Gari (Fraser Island) 4WD bus tour on another day. The order can be set around your travel dates. The island day visits Lake McKenzie, Central Station, Eli Creek, Eastern Beach, Pinnacle Coloured Sands, Seventy-Five Mile Beach and the Maheno shipwreck, with lunch and national park fees included.

trips.title: Aqua Oasis Cruise
trips.summary: A morning day cruise on Quick Cat II through the Great Sandy Straits to an anchorage, with about two hours of free time for swimming, stand up paddle boards, an inflatable slide and jumping platforms. Morning tea is included and all water equipment is provided. The boat is back at the marina at about 1:15pm, with a maximum of 40 guests.

trips.title: Private Charter
trips.summary: Quick Cat II can be hired for private events such as birthday parties, Christmas parties, work functions, hens and bucks days and engagement parties, from November to June. The crew tailor the cruise to the group, and catering can be arranged through the crew or brought by the group. Alcohol cannot be brought on board.

checkNotes: Site is on herveybaywhalewatch.com.au and redirects to the www address; read with plain requests and no bot check was hit. Rezdy booking links are opened through the site's own /bookings?u= wrapper; the bare Rezdy product links are recorded and no Rezdy page was opened. The /bookings page also embeds the Rezdy booking index for herveybaywhalewatch. Whale season is stated as 15 July to 15 October on the Whale Watching page (FAQ says mid July to October) and the site says the dates move each year with projected sightings, so confirm current dates before publishing; the cruises may be near the end of the season. Aqua Oasis runs November to May and charters November to June. Swim with the Whales is not its own tour, it is an extra on the morning and afternoon cruises ($100, age 13 and over, paid on board, not bookable online), so it is recorded as an offer and a price option instead of a trip. Not included as trips: 'Sunset Oasis' (named on the Aqua Oasis index page, no page, price or booking link found) and the K'Gari day tour on its own (not on the water). Conflicts and doubts: phone 1800 671 977 is on the contact page while trip pages give (07) 4128 9611 for delays; the home page says family owned for over 38 years while other pages say over 30 years; the FAQ and the Whales & Lunch page disagree on whether lunch includes a drink and name two different resort restaurants; the lunch upgrade is $40 on one Aqua Oasis page and $34 on another; the terms text mentions 'Calypso Hervey Bay', a second vessel not described anywhere else; /aqua-oasis-cruise-faqs returned an empty page twice so the FAQ page was used instead; the Accessibility and Inclusivity page says under construction. The site repeats a whale sighting guarantee (ticket valid for later cruises if no whales are seen) and superlatives such as first, longest running and best value; none are repeated as fact here. Cancellation: the FAQ says a full refund if the office is told 48 hours before departure. Group discount tiers are shown as percentages on the FAQ page and are not copied. Photos were not downloaded or viewed, so hero and gallery choices rest on file names and page position.
